profile.headline: Electrical & Computer Engineer | Native | Mobile | Web | Lead Software Developer | Full-Stack Architect | UI/UX Designer
profile.summary:
Skilled and well rounded Electrical and Computer Engineer that loves to design, create, and program to develop everything that imagination allows to be possible. 

My eye for graphic design and artistic creativity is what really distinguishes me from most engineers. I aim for pixel perfection and therefore most of the styling work gets thrown my way. When working in teams I am the one who likes to lay the foundation and at the end puts the cherry on top.

I consider myself an intelligent critical thinker for my ability to problem solve and quickly adapt to new environments. I like to be ambitious and take risks to expand my entrepreneurship skills. I passionately pursue new technologies and electronics that lead me to innovation. This helps me create new and improved tools. As I always say, "With the right tool anything is possible."

Aside from this, I seek to one day specialize in automotive technology.

positions.title: Software and Web Developer
positions.description:
Developed Sencha Touch mobile applications along side their complementary ExtJS administration web dashboards that communicated through a Spring RESTful web service.
Created a jQuery driven mobile application with PhoneGap from the grown up by myself.
Developed and styled web and cross platform mobile applications for multiple companies. ( Conoco Phillips, Valerus, etc...)
Programmed in multiple programming languages and frameworks.
Designed a Flash web application and tweaked Perl web services.
Developed time management skills by meeting deadlines and customer demands.
